brief_problem: The order delivered with no time

runs.text: The best error is the one that cannot be written.
The kiosk started making deliveries. An order is kept with four values:
How is an order represented so that those errors are impossible?
Write the possible states of an order and which data each one needs.
Pending: none. On its way: who carries it. Delivered: who carried it and at what time. Cancelled: why. Each state needs different data, and none needs all four.

entries.text: What goes in and what comes out?
An order goes in; its description comes out, or the next order.
Which part is calculation and which part touches the world?
Describing and moving an order forward is pure calculation.

blocks.description: Four states. Pending, without data, moves to on its way, with the courier, and on its way moves to delivered, with the courier and the time. From pending and from on its way it can be cancelled, with a reason. No arrow leaves delivered or cancelled.

caption.text: Each state carries only its data. The arrows are the possible changes; no arrow leaves delivered or cancelled.
